defs.def: extremely large in size or amount; great in degree 巨大的；极多的；程度高的

ex.s: Oaks and sweetgums, which currently account for a majority of the city’s trees, produce huge amounts of a chemical substance called isoprene.
ex.t: 目前占城市树木大多数的橡树和枫香树，会释放大量一种叫做异戊二烯的化学物质。

ex.s: I breathed a huge sigh of relief: I had expected sadness, maybe even doubt, but Dad was already looking to the future.
ex.t: 我长长地松了一口气：我本以为会是伤感，甚至可能是疑虑，但爸爸已经在展望未来。

ex.s: Yes, it was a huge goodbye in so many ways, but it was also the start of something new — an adventure in multigenerational living.
ex.t: 是的，从很多方面说这是一次巨大的告别，但它也是新事物的开端——一场多代同堂生活的冒险。

ex.s: “The food you have available makes a huge difference.
ex.t: 你手头有什么食物，会产生巨大的影响。

ex.s: One of the major headaches for her was finding her way in the huge school building.
ex.t: 对她来说，最头疼的事情之一就是在巨大的校舍里找路。

ex.s: Having a poor sense of direction, Eva found it impossible to get around in such a huge building.
ex.t: 由于方向感很差，伊娃发现在这样一座巨大的建筑里根本无法走动。

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了“人类约30万年前进化时所有语音都已存在”的流行观点。“我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来未必保持稳定，我们今天发现的极其多样的语音，是生物变化和文化演变等事物复杂相互作用的产物，”研究团队成员史蒂文·莫兰说。

ex.s: That includes huge savings in maintenance costs and better protection of railway personnel safety.
ex.t: 这包括维护成本的大幅节省和对铁路人员安全的更好保护。

ex.s: Who can provide Lancom with a huge potential for innovation in learning? （    ）
ex.t: 谁能给Lancom带来巨大的学习创新潜力？（    ）

ex.s: The distribution of these languages is hugely uneven.
ex.t: 这些语言的分布极不均匀。

ex.s: True to a gorilla’s unaggressive nature, the huge animal    69   (mean) me no real harm.
ex.t: 符合大猩猩不具攻击性的天性，这只巨兽___69___（mean）并无真正伤害我的意思。

ex.s: He finds the huge workload unbearable.
ex.t: 他很可能在桌子上跳跃。

ex.s: There are energy savings to be made from all recyclable materials, sometimes huge savings.
ex.t: 利用所有可回收材料可以节省能源，有时可以节省大量资源。

ex.s: These huge, strong animals can live for 30 years.
ex.t: 这些巨大而强壮的动物可以活30年。

ex.s: We spent the whole day hiking and I even saw the huge yaks!
ex.t: 我们花了一整天徒步旅行，我甚至看到巨大的牦牛！

ex.s: Jaws was a great success, attracting huge audiences and winning many awards.
ex.t: 在任何情况下，任何人都可以在未经允许和付费的情况下复制其内容。

ex.s: What’s more, huge advances in solar technology mean it can be eco-friendly, too.
ex.t: 而且，太阳能技术的巨大进步意味着它也可以生态友好。

ex.s: That huge sculpture you can see is the Winged Victory of Samothrace, or Nike of Samothrace!
ex.t: 你可以看到那巨大的雕塑 是萨摩太的胜利之翼 或萨摩太的耐克！

ex.s: Things quickly got very intense due to the huge amount of energy required to look after them.
ex.t: 由于照顾它们需要耗费巨大的精力，一切很快就变得十分紧张忙碌。

defs.def: very successful 非常成功的；走红的

ex.s: It can be imagined that comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the “computer simulation” metaphor-based model will also be a hugely rewarding exercise.
ex.t: 可以想象，与构建以往科学模型的过程类似，发展这种基于"计算机模拟"隐喻的模型也将是一项极具价值的实践。

ex.s: He built a hugely successful career with little more than plain old hard work and determination.
ex.t: 他仅凭朴实的努力和决心，就建立了极其成功的职业生涯。
